title: Jurisdiction policies — config/jurisdiction-policies.json
description: Feature gating per jurisdiction: autoplay, quick/turbo, slam stop, animation skip, bonus buy, enhanced chance, minimum round duration, stake caps, LDW suppression, and responsible-gambling displays. defaultPolicy is the mandatory most-restrictive fallback applied whenever the jurisdiction is unknown or unlisted. These values are engineering flags only, never legal conclusions.

policies.description: Named policies for known jurisdictions, unique by policyId (uniqueness enforced by the config validator).

defaultPolicy.description: The most-restrictive fallback used when the player's jurisdiction is UNKNOWN or has no entry in policies[]. Must disable autoplay, quick/turbo, slam stop, animation skip, bonus buy, and enhanced chance (asserted by the config validator and QA gate).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally with a subdivision suffix (e.g. 'DE', 'CA-ON'), or 'UNKNOWN'.

policyId.description: Kebab-case id of this policy, e.g. 'default-demo', 'uk-ukgc'.

notes.description: Optional: regulatory references or rationale (informational only).

flags.description: The gating flags for this jurisdiction.

autoplayEnabled.description: Whether autoplay is offered at all.

quickSpinEnabled.description: Whether the quick-spin presentation mode is offered.

turboSpinEnabled.description: Whether the turbo presentation mode is offered.

slamStopEnabled.description: Whether the player may slam-stop the reels early (presentation only; never changes the outcome).

animationSkipEnabled.description: Whether win/feature presentations can be skipped.

bonusBuyEnabled.description: Whether bonus-buy modes from config/bonus-buys.json are purchasable.

enhancedChanceEnabled.description: Whether an enhanced-chance (boosted trigger odds for higher stake) mode is offered.

minimumRoundDurationMs.description: Minimum wall-clock duration of one round in milliseconds (e.g. 2500 for UKGC-style rules), or null for no minimum.

maxStakeMinor.description: Jurisdiction stake cap in integer minor units (overrides game max bet when lower), or null for no cap.

ldwCelebrationSuppressed.description: When true, losses disguised as wins (win < stake) never celebrate above the 'small' presentation tier.

showRtp.description: Whether the RTP is displayed in the game info/help.

showMaximumWin.description: Whether the maximum win is displayed in the game info/help.

showGameHistory.description: Whether in-game round history is available to the player.

netPositionDisplay.description: Whether the session net win/loss position is permanently displayed.

sessionClockDisplay.description: Whether a session clock (elapsed time) is permanently displayed.

realityCheckMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between mandatory reality-check interruptions, or null when not required.
